note: Dashboards builds Layout Builder-based dashboard pages populated with pluggable Dashboard widgets that are also exposed as blocks. It defines: the 'dashboard' config entity (config names dashboards.dashboard.<id>; fields admin_label, category, sections, frontend, weight; collection /admin/structure/dashboards; canonical /dashboard/{dashboard}); the Dashboard plugin type (manager plugin.manager.dashboard, base DashboardBase, each plugin exposed as block dashboards_block:dashboard:<plugin_id>); the dashboards.settings config (colormap/alpha/shades for chart colors); and permissions 'administer dashboards' plus dynamic per-dashboard 'can view <id> dashboard' / 'can override <id> dashboard'. Medium/hard cases read/create dashboard entities and read the colormap setting, verified by loading the dashboard storage / config via drush.

evals.prompt: In the dashboards module, what plugin type do you implement to add a dashboard widget, and how does that widget become placeable in a dashboard's Layout Builder?
evals.expected_output: You implement a Dashboard plugin (@Dashboard annotation, extend DashboardBase, implement buildRenderArray()); the manager is plugin.manager.dashboard. Each Dashboard plugin is exposed as a block via a deriver, so in Layout Builder you place block dashboards_block:dashboard:<plugin_id>.

evals.prompt: What entity type does the dashboards module use for a dashboard, and where do you manage dashboards in the admin UI?
evals.expected_output: A 'dashboard' config entity (config names dashboards.dashboard.<id>) with Layout Builder sections. Manage them at /admin/structure/dashboards (route entity.dashboard.collection, the module's configure route); a dashboard renders at /dashboard/{dashboard}.

evals.prompt: How does the dashboards module control access — what is the global admin permission and what per-dashboard permissions are generated?
evals.expected_output: The global 'administer dashboards' permission governs the admin UI/forms/settings. DashboardsPermissions generates two permissions per dashboard: 'can view <id> dashboard' and 'can override <id> dashboard' (the latter enables the personal 'Personalize' override).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a dashboard (entity id dashboards_probe) created with the dashboards module. Inspect the live configuration and state the category it is assigned to.
evals.expected_output: dashboards_probe has admin_label 'KPI Probe' and category 'Ops Reporting'. Read with `drush cget dashboards.dashboard.dashboards_probe` or by loading the dashboard entity.

evals.prompt: On this site the dashboards module's chart color settings have been changed from the default. Inspect the live dashboards configuration and report which colormap is currently selected for dashboard charts.
evals.expected_output: colormap is 'viridis' in dashboards.settings (default is 'summer'). Discoverable via `drush cget dashboards.settings colormap`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the dashboards module to create a new dashboard with machine id 'dashboards_task', admin label 'Ops Overview', and category 'Operations'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A dashboard config entity dashboards_task exists with admin_label 'Ops Overview' and category 'Operations' (e.g. Dashboard::create([...])->save() or via /admin/structure/dashboards/add).

evals.prompt: I want a dashboard called 'Team Home' that shows up on the front end of my site (not just the admin area). Create it with the dashboards module and apply it live.
evals.expected_output: A dashboard config entity with admin_label 'Team Home' and frontend == TRUE exists (any machine id).
